components.css: .ds-line{display:flex;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #d5dbe3;font-family:Overpass,system-ui,sans-serif;--l:#1f5fad}.ds-line a{position:relative;padding:8px 10px 27px;color:#4a5566;text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;font-weight:550;white-space:nowrap}.ds-line a::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:9px;height:4px;background:var(--l)}.ds-line a:first-child::before{left:50%}.ds-line a:last-child::before{right:50%}.ds-line a::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:5px;width:12px;height:12px;margin-left:-6px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:3px solid var(--l);box-sizing:border-box;transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}.ds-line a:hover::after{transform:scale(1.15)}.ds-line a[aria-current=page]{color:#1b2330;font-weight:750}.ds-line a[aria-current=page]::after{width:18px;height:18px;margin-left:-9px;bottom:2px;background:var(--l);border:4px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--l)}.ds-line a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--l);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview: Home Cartel's order journey runs like Manila's rail lines: Procurement, the two supplier portals, Fulfillment and Delivery are each a line with its own flat colour, and every page is a station on it. The world lends only type, palette, density and that one signature move; layouts, tables and controls stay the ones staff already know from the Zoho app.
keyCharacteristics: Station-sign navy header over platform-concrete ground and white panels.
One flat line colour per section, used for the line itself, the current station and the primary action.
Overpass, a wayfinding face, with tabular figures in every table.
One-pixel hairlines, no gradients, no decorative shadows.
Status colours mean the same thing on every line.

rules.name: The Active Path Rule
rules.body: A line's colour appears only on its rail, the current station, the primary action, focus and selection. Never as decoration.

rules.name: The Same Signal Rule
rules.body: Status colours are global; a line colour never stands in for a status.

rules.name: The Columns Never Move Rule
rules.body: Tabular figures everywhere, so quantities, prices, dates and record numbers line up.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Table headers and labels are in sentence case; tracked all-caps labels are removed.

dos: Do give every new section a line: a flat colour, a short code, and text and on-fill variants that pass 4.5:1.
Do put new pages on their section's line as stations, in menu order.
Do restyle widgets only through theme.css tokens and adapters, never by editing widget files.
donts: Don't use a line colour for decoration, backgrounds of whole panels, or status.
Don't add gradients, glows, or shadows that carry meaning.
Don't make a page less dense than its Zoho original.
